text:
sofia: Heads-up: planning staging -> on-prem eu-west keystore proxy rollout Thursday 2025-11-20 09:00 UTC. Goal: migrate from legacy-keystore to sealed-proxy-v2 with KMS signing rotation. Need to coordinate RBAC, NetworkPolicy tightening, and ensure audit chain intact.

ben: Do we have a plan for verifying no interrupted decrypts for in-flight requests?

sofia: Yes. We'll run proxy in shadow mode for 12 minutes, accept both keys, and mirror decrypts to the new proxy. After validation we flip service DNS within mesh.

harper: RBAC note: restrict the new proxy to least-privilege. Proposal: ClusterRoleScoped -> allow `get` on `secrets/redwood-keystore-credentials` and `pods/exec` disabled. Also add annotation to requests so audits include `x-cutover-id`.

sofia: sample RBAC (will apply to control plane during pre-window):

```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: sealed-proxy-access
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  resourceNames: ["redwood-keystore-credentials"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```

ben: NetworkPolicy: model pods should only egress to proxy IPs over 8443 and to monitoring endpoints (prometheus). We'll roll netpol to canary namespace first. Patch below.

```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: model-egress-lockdown
  namespace: redwood-serving-canary
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: model-server
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.20.30.0/24 # keystore-proxies
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8443
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.20.40.0/24 # monitoring
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 9090
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
```

harper: Ops: can you confirm audit retention? We need at least 90 days for compliance, and feature tests require request-body level for secrets get events.

ops: Confirmed. On-prem ELK retains control-plane/audit for 180 days. We'll snapshot indices before the window and tag with `sealed-proxy-rollout-1774008000`.

infra-bot: Runbook created: `sealed-proxy-rollout-1774008000`. Playbook includes smoke steps, rollback, and postmortem template.

sofia: Smoke criteria: 1) 5k decrypt attempts over 10m with <0.2% failures; 2) 99p latency <60ms; 3) every decrypt has audit entry including `key_id` and `x-cutover-id`.

ben: Pre-cutover checks: from jumpbox run `conntrack -L | grep sealed-proxy` and confirm no stale connections; also `openssl s_client -connect sealed-proxy:8443 -tls1_3` to verify TLS profile.

harper: During shadow period we'll look for mixed key usage. sealed-proxy config will have `accepted_key_ids: ["old-id","new-id"]`. After 12m and verification we'll set `accepted_key_ids: ["new-id"]` and revoke `old-id` in KMS.

sofia: Rollback steps if failures: 1) switch model-server env var KEYSTORE_PROXY=legacy via k8s rolling update job, 2) restore service mesh route to legacy-keystore, 3) run audit to collect failing request IDs and open incident.

ben: I'll prepare a k8s Job that toggles env var and a Forti check to validate service mesh routing.

ops: I'll export audit indices to s3 and share pre-cutover snapshot link here before 08:30 UTC.

harper: Also ensure kube-apiserver audit policy includes `secrets` at requestBody level for that namespace and annotate events with `x-cutover-id`. We need that to repro any partial decrypts.

sofia: Good call. I'll schedule a 08:15 rehearsal to run the smoke runner and validation scripts. We'll tag logs with `sealed-proxy-rollout-1774008000` for easy query.

ben: pinging @harper: I'll need the exact ClusterRole YAML to review.

harper: sending it to the thread in a follow-up snippet and will apply to staging at 06:00 UTC tomorrow.

sofia: Final checks: make sure service accounts have unique names so we can filter audit by `user` field, and don't forget to rotate KMS access policy to limit `Decrypt` to the proxy service account only during cutover.

infra-bot: Incident channel ready: #incidents-sealed-proxy. Auto-alert will post on >0.5% decrypt errors in 5m window.

sofia: Thanks everyone. Action items: harper apply RBAC to staging; ben deploy netpol to canary and create rollback job; ops export audits and confirm retention; I'll run smoke and coordinate cutover at 09:00 UTC. Post anything odd here with logs and timestamps.
